value.rationale: The finite-distortion Koebe shear has order-two singularity, whereas the limiting harmonic Koebe map has order-three singularity. The open range of moments in which all finite-k moments exist but the k=1 moment fails is a motivated quantitative gap. The theorem determines a complete sharp scaling exponent and nontrivial explicit angular profile/coefficient uniformly across this continuum of q and β; it is not an arbitrarily chosen slice or minor numerical gain.
